alpha.note: Sec. 3.5 / Sec. 4; used with the GKD-consistent mixture (C1 finding), a ReproForge interpretation

ema_beta.note: EMA teacher updated after every gradient step; the EMA teacher is the evaluated model

loss_aggregation.value: per-sample masked token mean, then batch mean

filters.note: Table 5c disables pseudo-verification and the consensus gate before corrupting answers

wrong_fractions.note: Paper reports p in {0, 25, 50, 75}%; this analogue runs the end points only

corruption_scope.value: rationale value and answer letter replaced consistently
corruption_scope.note: Paper says only that candidate answers are replaced with wrong ones

model_id.note: Paper uses Gemma 4 E2B/E4B and Qwen3-4B-Base

task.note: Paper generates its own topic-seeded problems and evaluates on MMLU

adaptation.value: LoRA r=8, lora_alpha=16, dropout=0, targets q_proj/k_proj/v_proj/o_proj
adaptation.note: Paper does not state LoRA vs full fine-tuning

ema_scope.value: LoRA parameters only (base weights frozen, so this equals EMA over all weights)

epochs.note: 64 samples x 2 epochs / batch 4 = 32 gradient steps

sft_target.value: ' ' + z after the solution prompt, cross-entropy on z tokens only

eval_scoring.value: next-token log-likelihood of ' A'/' B'/' C'/' D' after 'Answer:', renormalised over the four letters
eval_scoring.note: Paper scores multiple-choice benchmarks by log-likelihood over the closed option set without thinking
